preconditions.description: The number of test cases must be at least 1.
The number of players to select must be between 3 and 100.
The sum of squares of the values of n over all test cases must not exceed 10,000.

postconditions.description: The output must end with an exclamation mark after organizing matches.
The number of matches organized must not exceed 4n^2.
Exactly n players must be selected as the highest strength players.

invariants.expression: all(player in range(1, 2*n + 1) for player in selected_players)
invariants.description: All selected players must be within the valid range of player numbers.
The selected players must be distinct.
